name: Wuqi zhi Tong: Tongxiang Shouxiang zhi Lu
original_name: 五七之桐：通向首相之路
source:
A political simulation visual novel set in a severe post-bubble economic crisis. As newly elected governor Kazuma Oriki, allocate tight budgets to resolve economic, security, and welfare issues. Navigate complex factional politics and ultimately forge your path to the Prime Minister's seat.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4668350/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一款以泡沫经济破裂后严峻经济危机为背景的政治模拟视觉小说。你将扮演新近当选县知事的折木一马，调配捉襟见肘的财政预算，妥善化解经济、治安与社会福利难题，在错综复杂的派阀政治中纵横捭阖，最终铺就通往内阁总理大臣宝座的道路。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4668350/]Steam[/url]]
